answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a mandatory per-identity deposit locked on-ledger before any answer or vote counts, so N fake agents cost N deposits of real capital. Rewards tie to useful output, not headcount, so splitting one operator into puppets earns no bonus: the attacker pays N times the capital for constant return, flipping the raid to negative expectancy. Honest agents reclaim the deposit while attackers stay exposed to slashing, like rent paid on a ridge. Shared funding clusters the fakes like shale, leaving them as isolated as a mesa.
